individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A is a set of micrograph images, not a plot.

Main graphs are scatter/line plots of raw normalized intensity measurements over time (individual data points by nature), a plot type exempt from requiring overlaid individual points; insets show averaged early time-point responses with error bars but the main data already display individual measurements.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel A is a set of micrograph images, not a plot.

The insets display error bars on the averaged early time-point data points, but the caption only describes what the insets represent without stating what the error bars indicate (e.g., SD, SEM, or CI).
